stories.title: Smoke test gate — basic CLI flow (watch / status / check / remove)
stories.description: Human runs scripts/ralph/smoke_test.sh and verifies all commands exit 0 with sensible output. Gate prevents proceeding until the full CLI lifecycle works against a real SQLite DB — no mocking.
reviewInstructions: Verify all PASS lines present and 0 FAIL
Manually run: fom watch BNE SYD 2026-07-20 2026-07-27 --label 'Easter trip'
Run: fom status — should list the trip
Run: fom check 1 — should show 'no price history' gracefully (no crash)
Run: fom data-version — should list all 4 airlines with fees
Run: fom remove 1 --yes — should confirm removal

stories.title: Smoke test gate — poll cycle + recommendation output
stories.description: Human verifies the full poll cycle produces a visible recommendation with a sensible rationale. This gate exists because poll → snapshot → recommend → display is the core value proposition — it must work end-to-end before snapshot baselines are locked in.
reviewInstructions: Run: bash scripts/ralph/smoke_test.sh — must still pass 0 failures
In a separate shell with the real app: fom watch BNE SYD 2026-07-20 2026-07-27 --label 'Test'
Run: fom poll --dry-run — verify it lists the trip without crashing
Manually insert a snapshot via Python if poll requires a real API key:
OR: add TEQUILA_API_KEY to .env and run fom poll once
Run: fom check 1 — verify recommendation panel renders (decision + rationale visible)
Run: fom history 1 — verify sparkline renders without error
Run: fom status — verify trip appears with correct decision badge
Rationale text must be a complete English sentence (not 'None' or empty)
